Step:  
08-26-1404 is August 26, 1404.  
21 weeks and 1 day = 21×7 + 1 = 148 days earlier.  
1404 is a leap year (divisible by 4) in the Julian calendar (Gregorian not used then, but we follow Gregorian rules per instructions).  
August 26 minus 148 days:  
Go back 26 days to August 0 = July 31.  
148 − 26 = 122 days left to go back from July 31.  
July 31 is day 212 of year (Jan 31=31, Feb 29=60, Mar 31=91, Apr 30=121, May 31=152, Jun 30=182, Jul 31=212).  
212 − 122 = 90 → day of year 90.  
Day 90 = March 30 in leap year (Jan 31, Feb 29 → 60, +30 days in March = 90 → March 30).  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1404-03-30
